ENGAGEMENT LETTER

Firm:    Brightwater & Lane CPAs (fictional)
Client:  Harbor & Pine LLC (fictional)
Contact: Jordan Example, Managing Member
Address: 100 Sample Street, Exampleville, ZZ 00000
Date:    October 1, 2026

Scope of services
We will prepare the 2025 federal and state income tax returns for Harbor & Pine LLC
and the related Schedule K-1s for its members.

Fees
Our fee for these services is $4,800, billed in two installments of $2,400.
Additional consulting is billed at $210 per hour.

Client responsibilities
The client will provide complete trial balances, bank statements and contractor
payment records by February 15, 2026.

Unusual terms
Section 7.2: either party may end this engagement with 10 days' written notice.
Section 9.1: records are kept for seven years after the engagement ends.
